category_title: Children from lower socioeconomic backgrounds experiencing daily stressors and ruminative thoughts
scenario_title: Rumination and mind-wandering during mindfulness practice
minimal_context: The student is attempting to clear their mind during a classroom mindfulness session while other students are present.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our mindfulness session. Please sit quietly and try to clear your mind.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm finding it difficult to focus right now because there are people messing around over there.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to ignore them and concentrate on the exercise.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm trying to use the breathing so it feels like I was in a silent room, but my mind keeps wandering and I keep having stressful invading thoughts.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to push those thoughts away and clear your mind.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I tried to clear my mind but I’m still worried… my head is filled with lots of things. It’s like I’m holding two big pots filled with hundreds of heavy things.
